messages:
Kai M: Quick one for folks going to Prague for the offsite: are you planning to bring back big souvenirs (porcelain/marionettes) or stick to carry-on-friendly stuff?
Anya R: Carry-on for me 4bf too many luggage horror stories. small magnets and coffee bags only.
Luca F: Might pick up a wooden puppet 3a2 but could ship it home from the hotel. anyone tried hotel shipping?
Zoe L: Hotel concierge will usually help but expect a small fee. pre-approve with People Ops if you're shipping for work swag.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: Shipping for conference materials must be preapproved. See travel policy: https://intranet/travel-policy (attach invoice to expenses).
Kai M: Poll: react 4bf = Carry-on only, 4e6 = Ship from hotel, 6b2 = Bring checked bag (big gifts).
Anya R: 4bf
Luca F: 4e6
Zoe L: 4e6 (concierge tip: write "Do not open" on return label if you want it boxed back)
Kai M: Also FYI: tram transfers are cheap 68c and most conference hotels are 10-20 min from the old town. packing tip: a light foldable tote for market finds.
Anya R: Good call. I'll bring a tote and avoid checking anything.
Luca F: I'll ask Ops about shipping labels. thanks!
